contract.note: Reading 'loses money' per use as serving revenue against serving cost is an ordinary reading. Choosing August 2024 is reasonable. The universal 'every' wording is kept, not stretched.

evidence.note: An unverified FutureSearch model of API margins for June 2024. The authors say it is unchecked. It also mentions reported positive compute margins on paid products, but that figure is unconfirmed and not use-level data, so it does not settle the claim.

reviews.rationale: No verified use-level or subscriber-level unit economics for August 2024 are in the packet. The modeled positive API margins, and the secondhand compute-margin figures for paid products, point against a loss on every use, but they are unverified and do not meet the source requirements. Company-wide losses cannot prove a loss on every use. The evidence settles neither direction.

contract.note: Requiring proof of the stated unit-loss premise and an identified investor's concern is fair. Reading 'stand on its own two feet' as self-financing is an ordinary reading.
